title: ArchieParrot
description: this resoursepack adds Yellow Parrots Archie.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3f5e2ad8428dc93edea5674ea9d159a8992f42a.png) --- Tweet everyone! I'm Archie, the yellow and white parrot from this resource pack! My owner will tell you more! This resource pack replaces all parrots with Archie. This resource pack also adds spawn eggs from version 1.21.5 to older versions, and this resource pack also changes the parrot spawn egg into a beautiful yellow and white egg-shaped parrot. I have this parrot at home. I copied its color from a photo I took as a keepsake and painted a texture for our resource pack. Have a nice day, everyone! ---
--- But Archie died today... 12/14/2025 - 06/12/2026 The Archie Parrot project is ready.
